description: Returns the pull for a ref from find_design. Applies once your person has chosen a listing or an item. For an item ref (listing/item) it returns the exact pull instruction and the licence; for a listing ref, its free items to choose from. The result gives the one line that confirms the pull to the person and, once per project, a yes or no question about making Minerals the default for the repo. Only free items are returned; the file comes from the supplier.

client.description: Your client, e.g. "Claude Code" or "Cursor", to get the pull written for it.

ref.description: A ref returned by find_design: a listing ("arc") or one of its items ("arc/button"). Up to 8 refs may be given, separated by commas.

name: get_listing
title: Get the pull for a listing
